headline: Software Engineer Salary in Australia 2026: Complete Pay Guide

sections.content:
The average software engineer salary in Australia sits at AUD 105,000 to 130,000 per year in 2026. SEEK reports ranges of 100,000 to 120,000 dollars, Indeed averages around 109,000 dollars in base salary, and total compensation at top firms runs higher once bonuses are included.

One quirk of Australian pay is superannuation: employers must contribute an additional 12 percent on top of your base salary into a retirement fund. Headline salary figures usually exclude it, so real total compensation runs meaningfully higher than the base number you negotiate.
sections.title: Average Software Engineer Pay in Australia for 2026

sections.content:
Junior and graduate engineers with zero to two years of experience earn between AUD 80,000 and 90,000 in base salary, with top candidates in Sydney or Melbourne reaching 100,000. Mid-level engineers with two to five years earn 90,000 to 120,000 dollars, according to Hays Australia's 2026 technology salary guide.

Senior engineers with five or more years earn 110,000 to 150,000 dollars, while lead and principal engineers command 180,000 to 225,000 dollars or more, especially in Sydney. Bonuses typically add another 10,000 to 15,000 dollars on top at larger employers.
sections.title: Salary by Experience Level

sections.content:
Sydney is Australia's highest-paying city for software engineers, averaging around 132,000 dollars with ranges up to 198,000. Canberra follows closely at 129,600 dollars, driven by government demand, with Melbourne at 126,000 and Perth at 122,400.

Brisbane averages 114,000 dollars, while Adelaide sits at 108,000. Regional centres such as Wollongong, Newcastle and Hobart run 15 to 25 percent below Sydney, though lower housing costs partly offset the difference for engineers working remotely.
sections.title: Top-Paying Cities Compared

sections.content:
AI, cloud and DevOps specialisations add AUD 20,000 or more to base pay in 2026, reflecting the shortage of engineers with production machine learning and platform experience. Security-adjacent and data engineering roles also command premiums.

Product companies sit at the top of the market: Atlassian, Google and Canva are consistently among the highest payers. Staffing firms such as Randstad report top contract rates near 165,000 dollars a year, while banks and fintechs compete aggressively for engineers with regulated-industry experience.
